title: Test damaged handoff indexes in expiry sweeps and recipient discovery
outcome: Test damaged handoff indexes in expiry sweeps and recipient discovery
acceptance: A holder mutation that sweeps a cancelled offer whose index state was reset to offered after its expiry returns InvalidWorkProjection, leaves the database shape unchanged, and appends no expiry event.
A recipient peek over an offer whose indexed expiry millisecond disagrees with its canonical expiry refuses the recipient binding without mutation.

completion.summary: Added discriminating regressions for damaged handoff indexes in expiry sweeps and recipient discovery; both criteria delivered and independently passed 2/2 on unchanged acceptance revision 1. Full gate and Codex/Claude whole-input reviews passed; pushed and installed the exact tested tree.
